subject: maths
question: A cylindrical pillar has a diameter of 10 cm and a height of 35 cm. The curved surface is to be painted at a cost of ₹12/cm². If a 10% discount is offered on the total painting cost, how much will be paid? (Use π = (22)/(7) )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius = 5 cm, Height = 35 cm

CSA = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 5 × 35 = 1100 cm²

Cost before discount = 1100 × 12 = 13200

After 10% discount ⇒ pay 90% ⇒ 13200 × 0.9

= 11880

**∴ Answer = 11880**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter = 10 cm ⇒ Radius = 5 cm, Height = 35 cm

Cost = ₹12/cm², Discount = 10%

**Formula used:**

Curved Surface Area = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

⇒ CSA = 2 × (22/7) × 5 × 35

⇒ CSA = 1100 cm²

⇒ Total cost = 1100 × 12 = 13200

⇒ Discount = 10% of 13200 = 1320

⇒ Final cost = 13200 − 1320 = 11880

**∴ The correct answer is 11880.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Cylinder

CSA = 2πrh, where r is radius and h is height.

Discount Formula

Final Price = Original Price × (1 − Discount/100).

Unit Consistency

Ensure area is in cm² before multiplying with cost per cm².
